analysis_completion_valid.name: analysis_completion_valid
analysis_completion_valid.value: "analysis_runs"."completed_at" is null or ("analysis_runs"."started_at" is not null and "analysis_runs"."completed_at" >= "analysis_runs"."started_at")

audit_genesis_consistent.name: audit_genesis_consistent
audit_genesis_consistent.value: ("audit_events"."sequence" = 1 and "audit_events"."previous_hash" is null) or ("audit_events"."sequence" > 1 and "audit_events"."previous_hash" is not null)

audit_actor_consistent.name: audit_actor_consistent
audit_actor_consistent.value: ("audit_events"."actor_type" = 'user' and "audit_events"."actor_membership_id" is not null) or ("audit_events"."actor_type" = 'service' and "audit_events"."actor_membership_id" is null)

audit_stream_heads_genesis_consistent.name: audit_stream_heads_genesis_consistent
audit_stream_heads_genesis_consistent.value: ("audit_stream_heads"."last_sequence" = 0 and "audit_stream_heads"."last_event_hash" is null) or ("audit_stream_heads"."last_sequence" > 0 and "audit_stream_heads"."last_event_hash" is not null)

clinical_section_versions_human_review_v.name: clinical_section_versions_human_review_valid
clinical_section_versions_human_review_v.value: ("clinical_section_versions"."review_state" not in ('reviewed', 'explicitly_absent')) or ("clinical_section_versions"."reviewed_by_membership_id" is not null and "clinical_section_versions"."reviewed_at" is not null)

command_idempotency_completion_consisten.name: command_idempotency_completion_consistent
command_idempotency_completion_consisten.value: ("command_idempotency"."status" = 'processing' and "command_idempotency"."completed_at" is null) or ("command_idempotency"."status" <> 'processing' and "command_idempotency"."completed_at" is not null)

encounters_timing_valid.name: encounters_timing_valid
encounters_timing_valid.value: "encounters"."ended_at" is null or ("encounters"."started_at" is not null and "encounters"."ended_at" >= "encounters"."started_at")

outbox_lease_consistent.name: outbox_lease_consistent
outbox_lease_consistent.value: ("outbox_events"."status" = 'processing' and "outbox_events"."lease_owner" is not null and "outbox_events"."lease_expires_at" is not null and "outbox_events"."claimed_at" is not null) or ("outbox_events"."status" <> 'processing')

protocol_versions_signature_consistent.name: protocol_versions_signature_consistent
protocol_versions_signature_consistent.value: ("protocol_versions"."status" = 'signed' and "protocol_versions"."signed_by_membership_id" is not null and "protocol_versions"."signed_at" is not null) or ("protocol_versions"."status" = 'draft' and "protocol_versions"."signed_by_membership_id" is null and "protocol_versions"."signed_at" is null)

review_decisions_transition_consistent.name: review_decisions_transition_consistent
review_decisions_transition_consistent.value: ("review_decisions"."decision" = 'accept' and "review_decisions"."result_state" = 'accepted') or ("review_decisions"."decision" = 'edit_and_accept' and "review_decisions"."result_state" = 'edited_and_accepted') or ("review_decisions"."decision" = 'reject' and "review_decisions"."result_state" = 'rejected') or ("review_decisions"."decision" = 'restore' and "review_decisions"."result_state" = 'proposed')

transcript_correction_has_provenance.name: transcript_correction_has_provenance
transcript_correction_has_provenance.value: "transcript_segments"."state" <> 'corrected' or ("transcript_segments"."supersedes_segment_id" is not null and "transcript_segments"."corrected_by_membership_id" is not null)
